edits.old: - RWB-P4-E1037-CON is published (H): the nine contract tables of this service, the four operations of section 12.1, the load and approve shapes, the approver rule, the error vocabulary and the fakes. This story implements it and adds no path.
edits.new:
- RWB-P4-E1037-CON is published (H): the nine contract tables of this service, the four operations of section 12.1, the load and approve shapes, the approver rule, the error vocabulary and the fakes. This story implements it and adds no path.
- The six non-human actors (SY-CASEWF, SY-RULES, SY-RECOVERY, SY-OCR, SY-DECLOG, SY-AGENT) are resolved through POST /authorise with their SY role code and their managed identity as the subject; the credential type is set by RWB-P4-E1037-CON.

edits.old: the scopes OWN, TEAM, REGION and ALL
edits.new: the scopes Own, Team, All and Placed cases as the Key tab lists them (a region predicate is decided by the P4 and P3 design)

edits.old: Neither this story nor its contract copies a legacy section wholesale, and neither claims the other's deliverable.
edits.new: Neither this story nor its contract copies a legacy section wholesale, and neither claims the other's deliverable. Masking home: the function `recovery.ace_mask_value(...)` stays in the recovery view schema with the views, the masking policy rows stay in `rwb_access` (this story), and rwb-source-data applies the mask in the view and in its responses. A read of a personal field goes to the ACE Common PII logging path to the SOC (INT-34); the Recovery business-event topics are separate from that path and carry no personal data. A partner user is created and ended by the S9 rwb-partner administrator; the roles it holds are permission rows granted by the P4 role owner; both actions are written to the access log. The screen response is composed at the edge and owned by RWB-PLT-EDGE; the partner gateway is RWB-PLT-EDGE with S9 rwb-partner behind it.
